selection_rule: Every remaining design with baseline/baseline.json, inputs/contract/manifest.json and inputs/vpr_input.nodes after excluding the three FusionPAR development designs; no filtering on FusionPAR output or baseline QoR

tracks.budget_semantics: Same requested primary count; staged combines legal nonoverlapping moves into a batch while interleaved reselects after each commit. Actual native evaluation and moved-block counts must be reported; this is not an equal-native-evaluation comparison.
Primary and repair both consume the nine-evaluation budget; require both modes to reach nine before labeling equal evaluations. Candidate exhaustion retained and reported.

fixed_policy.timing: Native full connection criticality at initial state and each accepted commit
fixed_policy.acceptance: Strict native (WL, CPD) lexicographic improvement; both metrics <=102% original baseline
fixed_policy.repair: Existing bounded failure-feedback repair; no per-design policy changes
fixed_policy.start: Original legal routed baseline, no pre-optimization by TP or FusionPAR

freeze_and_execution: Bind all input artifacts, source inventory and native binaries before outcome inspection; preserve per-suite source copies and verify unchanged sources across the full cohort
Preflight only the supported converter/identity/contract boundary; preserve every failure without replacing a design or adapting the policy
Use the same XML backend and policy on every design and mode, including slower or unsuccessful runs
Run measurement subprocesses sequentially; complete all measurements before independent audits
Archive every host process, candidate, native certificate, timing update, failure and complete costs; charge full measured conversion to each sample and separately report build costs
required_analysis: Five-repeat full state/event/timing determinism and independent atomic-publication/native legality audits
Per-design legal final quality, strict-improvement counts, actual evaluations, moved instances, repair attempts, searches, node expansions and wall time
All initialization/conversion, candidate generation, native validation/STA, rejection and fallback costs retained; no sum of overlapping nested timers
Report coverage denominator of all six selected inputs, including unsupported and failed cases
No tuning after results; any algorithm change starts a new development phase and invalidates this cohort as untouched validation for the changed policy
limits: Independent of FusionPAR development outcomes, not a universally untouched dataset: these inputs have prior TilePlace provenance
Local routed-design refinement, not full P&R from packing
Homogeneous single-layer supported mapping boundary; unsupported input is a coverage failure, not zero runtime
Shared-stage and equal-evaluation controls isolate different questions; neither establishes superiority over all mature placers
No physical U280, HBM throughput, board power or FPGA speedup claim
